name: Talleyrand Simulator
source:
An ancient feudal regime is rotting away French power and prestige. France’s creditors demand change – and boy, oh boy, are they about to get some change. Revolutions, executions, conspiracies, wars, and coups abound. Europe will be quite rocked.

And as the sleaziest, scummiest socialite in France, surely you can make use of some of that chaos, right?

You are Foreign Minister Talleyrand, and you ride atop a wave of 40 years of French history, scooping up all the cash, lovers, power, and personal victories you can along the way. 

Leave your legacy as the most cunning, cutthroat, charismatic cat on the continent, or die trying.

古老的封建政权正在侵蚀法国的权力和威望。法国债权人要求改变——天哪，天哪，他们即将得到一些改变吗？革命、处决、阴谋、战争和政变比比皆是。欧洲将会相当震惊。

作为法国最肮脏、最卑鄙的社交名流，你当然可以利用一些混乱，对吧？

你是外交部长塔列朗，在法国40年历史的浪潮中乘风破浪，一路上攫取所有金钱、情人、权力和个人胜利。

留下你作为这片大陆上最狡猾、最残忍、最有魅力的猫的遗产，否则就会死去。
